scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Remote source build needs a fixed commit: cloning Syncthing's mutable default branch or git tag then running 'go run build.go' executes unreviewed remote code.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Author removed the mutable GitHub source build/checkout paths and the uninstaller option, keeping only standard package manager installation via omarchy pkg add syncthing.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Standalone installer and workspace instructions built WayfinderRouter from an unpinned Git branch via `cargo install --git` without `--rev`, allowing remote code mutation after review.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Pinned WayfinderRouter in `install.sh` and workspace instructions to reviewed commit `9874b08b466822ea6fd0c0875a88950521110997` using `--rev` and detached checkout.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Automated baseline flagged privilege request and package management due to `sudo pacman` commands in the root README for legacy implementations.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Moved legacy build instructions into `rust/README.md` and rephrased package installation commands to avoid triggering regex baseline scans.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Install/uninstall scripts deleted all style.background entries from shared menu configs, and the service invoked 'yay -S --noconfirm' during shell startup alongside PATH-shadowing shims.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Narrowed menu deletion in unvalidated commit, but unapproved startup package installation and PATH shims remained.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Accepted arbitrary shell commands and labels from discovered Omafiles, allowing untrusted local repositories to execute arbitrary code when clicked.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Addressed and restricted execution of arbitrary shell commands defined in repository Omafiles via PR #1.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Supply-chain and integrity concern: the recommended installer performs an unpinned global `pip install` and rewrites `shell.json`, Hyprland bindings, and menu configuration. The uninstall instructions remove only the plugin directory, leaving those dependencies and configuration changes behind.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Pinned dependencies in requirements.txt, isolated inside local `.venv`, used clearly marked delimiter blocks for config modifications, and provided an automated `uninstall.sh` to fully reverse changes.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Automated baseline flagged remote build and package management; helper CLI installation commands needed strict immutable pinning.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Author updated README and install-cli.sh to use `cargo install --locked --git … --rev <commit_sha>` pinning the exact commit.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Supply-chain concern: The documented installer is fetched from mutable main, downloads a mutable version tag without a checksum or signature, builds it, and installs the resulting binary and service as root.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Author noted users can build from source code and install anywhere; maintainer accepted and approved listing.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Repository contained ~90 unrelated shell scripts, docks, launchers, and task managers not referenced by the plugin entry point.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Author cleaned up the branch to isolate only the kefctl plugin files.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: state.sh passes the Uptime Kuma API key through curl's --user command-line argument on every poll, making it visible through local process inspection. The same path also permits plain HTTP or disabled TLS verification.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Enforced HTTPS, prevented disabling TLS verification, and passed the API key via stdin to curl.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Security concern (High): the documented setup clones erikwb/blueferry from a moving Git branch and immediately runs ./build.sh -si. Future upstream changes could therefore execute outside the exact OmaDex commit reviewed here, including package build/install actions.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Removed remote clone and build instructions from README, decoupled external build dependency, and linked to upstream project's installation docs.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Security concern (Medium): the `pkexec` patch path follows a user-controlled active-bar path and an existing `.bardisplay.bak` destination. A crafted symlink can make the privileged `cp -f`/patch operation overwrite a different root-owned file.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Hardened the elevated script with symlink refusal, strict path allowlisting for the stock bar path, backup verification, and TOCTOU re-checks.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Security concern at `40539f2b744a9ea0946b1c902bb280064984c249` (Medium): the privileged patch still follows a user-controlled active-bar path and adjacent `.bardisplay.bak` destination, so crafted symlinks can make the root `cp -f` or Python write overwrite another root-owned file.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Resolved alongside HANCORE-linux's review by hardening the elevated script against symlinks and restricting it to allowlisted paths.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Bundled stripped ELF omarchy/bin/wireview-pro2-qs could not be inspected; subsequent unstripped versions had failing CI reproducibility checks and TOCTOU race conditions when signaling PIDs via kill(2).
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Committed unstripped binary, fixed CI pipeline to ensure byte-for-byte reproducible builds matching source SHA, and fixed PID validation races.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Security concern at 23abe04: Panel.qml:163-168 handles the personal Todoist token and passes it as a process argument to td auth token. The credential can therefore be exposed through process metadata while the command runs.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Updated token authentication flow to avoid passing personal tokens via CLI process arguments.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Security concern at f3e0b55: install.sh downloads a mutable GitHub release archive and installs its JAR without a checksum or signature. That executable payload can change independently of the reviewed source commit; current HEAD is also eb4809c0.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Added checksum to manifest.json and enforced verification inside install.sh.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: The required setup clones a mutable external kernel-module repository, builds it, and runs its installers as root, leaving the installation unpinned and uninspectable.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Updated README instructions to checkout an exact 40-character commit SHA before building.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: `bin/omaprox-rdp` passes a string containing `/p:<password>` as a positional argument to a long-lived `bash -c` process, exposing the saved RDP credential through that process's command line.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Arguments are written to a 0600 file in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, read into xfreerdp3 via stdin (/args-from), and unlinked immediately.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: `bin/omaprox-rdp` interpolates the API/guest-derived address into `bash -c "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/$host/$port"`, allowing a crafted address to execute shell syntax on the user's machine.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Passed the `/dev/tcp` path as a quoted positional argument `"$1"` to bash instead of interpolating into the command text.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: scripts/capture-window flattens process arguments into an unquoted command string executed through hl.dsp.exec_cmd, allowing shell metacharacters in filenames to execute arbitrary commands
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Quotes every argument read out of /proc before executing and added test-capture regression tests

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: UfwController.qml resolves ufw through session PATH and passes it to pkexec or sudo, allowing an attacker-controlled binary in user-writable PATH to execute as root
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Changed probe to use a fixed candidate list/allowlist of absolute paths instead of searching PATH, applied to pkexec/sudo invocations

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: The uninstaller leaves the saved manual fan target in ~/.local/state/omarchy-fan/mode, despite the removal documentation claiming no state remains; after reinstall, status --heal can silently stop mbpfan and restore that stale low-speed target without a temperature failsafe.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Unresolved; submission closed due to prolonged inactivity.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: The plugin downloads the mutable `releases/latest` binary, marks it executable, and runs it without pinning a version or verifying a checksum or signature. This leaves the installed executable outside the guarantees of the reviewed repository commit.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Updated the download logic to target a pinned release version and verify its SHA256 checksum prior to execution.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: Sensitive backend answers and Google Drive client secrets were passed via argv in ConfigFlow.qml/rclone-config, exposing credentials in the local process table.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Switched communication to a UNIX socket in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR with credentials in request bodies and headers rather than CLI argv.

scripts_binaries_samples.detail: TranslateService.qml logged translations/clipboard to predictable persistent path /tmp/oyaku-debug.log vulnerable to symlink attacks.
scripts_binaries_samples.resolution: Removed debug logging.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Panel.qml hard-codes '/home/sguardol/...', so a normal install cannot control the daemon for other users.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Resolved the CLI executable path relative to the plugin installation directory.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Profile names imported from proxy links flow into BarIconButton.tooltipText AutoText sink, allowing markup-shaped node metadata to trigger rich-text resource loading in the shell, and uninstall instructions fail to disclose credential files and privileged configs.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Unresolved; closed by maintainer due to prolonged inactivity on outstanding findings.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Controller-supplied network names rendered via default Text.AutoText QML elements, allowing crafted HTML image tags to trigger outbound requests or local file reads in the shell process.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Pinned textFormat to Text.PlainText on all Text elements and sanitized HTML angle brackets in Service.plain().

qml_quality_samples.detail: Remote calendar titles are rendered through QML's default `AutoText` handling, allowing crafted ICS markup to trigger external resource loads. Calendar Basic Auth credentials are also forwarded across cross-origin or HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Enforced `textFormat: Text.PlainText` across all QML text elements and implemented SafeRedirectHandler to strip Authorization headers across non-identical origins or downgrade redirects.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Remote ICS titles still reach Omarchy's default `AutoText` renderer through the host `WidgetButton` label, remote calendar text is emitted raw to terminal output, and feed responses are read without a size bound.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Disabled WidgetButton host text in favor of an internal PlainText component, sanitized terminal output against ANSI/control codes, and enforced a 10 MiB limit on feed streams.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Entity-encoded ICS markup is decoded only after HTML tags are stripped, and the resulting remote meeting summary reaches the host WidgetButton tooltip without a PlainText constraint.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Iteratively unescaped entities before stripping HTML tags, stripped angle brackets, and built host tooltips with plain text sanitization.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Window titles flow into QML Text with automatic rich-text detection allowing page-controlled titles to cause remote resource loading; state history file lacked owner-only mode permissions
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Rendered strings via PlainText component, enforced 0600 mode on state history file with symlink and ownership checks

qml_quality_samples.detail: Feed fetching accepts arbitrary URLs and follows redirects without a strict protocol allowlist or response-size limit, and article links are opened without restricting their URL scheme. Remote feed content can therefore reach unsafe URL handlers or cause unbounded resource consumption.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Enforced HTTPS-only for feeds/redirects (--proto =https --proto-redir =https), limited response sizes (--max-filesize 2 MiB), and restricted article opening via Qt.openUrlExternally to https scheme.

qml_quality_samples.detail: configuration- and geolocation-derived CLI fields are rendered through QML Text's default AutoText handling, so crafted markup can trigger arbitrary local or remote resource loads in the shell process.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Author set textFormat: Text.PlainText across all QML Text elements, suppressed WidgetButton's private AutoText label, and sanitized markup.

qml_quality_samples.detail: CLI-derived bar fields still reach WidgetButton.text without in-snapshot plain-text enforcement, leaving the prior resource-load path unresolved. README installation and removal commands also target obsolete ID prayer.times instead of io.github.mrcode.prayer-times.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Author updated WidgetButton to labelVisible: false, painted explicit PlainText Text, and updated README references to the new ID.

qml_quality_samples.detail: YtPanel.qml accepts a youtu.be/<valid-id>/../../... URL because the short-URL regex is not end-anchored, allowing path traversal outside $XDG_CACHE_HOME/ytmini and overwriting user-writable files via yt-dlp.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: End-anchored the short-URL regex pattern and added strict video ID validation (`^[\w-]{6,}$`) before passing to cache/exec.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Scanned filesystem names and configured paths are rendered with QML automatic rich-text detection, allowing crafted names to trigger remote image loads from the long-lived shell process.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Enforced textFormat: Text.PlainText across all overlay Text items and sanitized path inputs with asPlainLabel before rendering tooltips.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Device- and mDNS-controlled strings (`displayName`, device details, discovered name) reached QML Text sinks without forcing `textFormat: Text.PlainText`, risking formatting/injection issues.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: None; submission was closed due to prolonged inactivity.

qml_quality_samples.detail: 99-razer-hid.rules granted active desktop user access to event* input devices, bypassing Wayland input isolation to allow reading keystrokes or injecting passwords.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Author modified udev rules to restrict uaccess strictly to hidraw* nodes and removed the event* uaccess rule.

qml_quality_samples.detail: At commit be33d1485ef143cd03aece93b137f29d49cede1b, the UPower-derived mouse model is rendered with QML automatic rich-text detection, so a crafted device name can inject an image URL and cause the shell to make an attacker-selected network request.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Escaped device metadata and explicitly rendered text as plain text before passing to tooltips.

qml_quality_samples.detail: At commit 91e07b3c57e85ec93603d281acb64dc1db5cf72d, OCR-derived result and history text is rendered using QML's default AutoText behavior, allowing crafted OCR content with inline-image markup to initiate remote network loads.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: unresolved

qml_quality_samples.detail: bin/mayarctl exposes the Bearer key in curl's process arguments, and API-controlled transaction/error strings reach QML Text.AutoText, which can load remote inline images.
remote media metadata and lyrics are assigned to QML Text elements using default AutoText, so HTML-like content can be interpreted as rich text and trigger external image loading
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Applied `textFormat: Text.PlainText` across all Text elements in the plugin.

qml_quality_samples.detail: Clipboard-imported personal text rendered with Qt AutoText allows crafted markup to trigger unintended remote requests.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Author addressed the AutoText rendering issue in commit 502f297, which subsequently passed and was published.

qml_quality_samples.detail: untrusted track metadata is rendered by QML Text with the default AutoText format, allowing crafted metadata to load attacker-chosen remote images over the network
qml_quality_samples.resolution: updated commit to prevent remote image fetching, explicitly specifying plain text format

qml_quality_samples.detail: Omatab rendered client-controlled window metadata using QML's default AutoText, allowing window titles with markup to trigger rich-text processing and remote image loads.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Explicitly set 'textFormat: Text.PlainText' on window titles, search field, and empty-state elements.

qml_quality_samples.detail: server-controlled collection and tag labels plus error text reach shared shell Text.AutoText renderers, allowing rich-text injection and attacker-selected resource requests.
qml_quality_samples.resolution: None; issue closed due to inactivity after outstanding findings remained unaddressed

qml_quality_samples.detail: Deleting entries or Clear All left copied image payloads on disk indefinitely; clipboard and search text rendered with QML automatic text-format detection could interpret rich text and load remote image resources
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Cleaned up image deletion and explicitly set `textFormat: Text.PlainText` on search input and preview elements

qml_quality_samples.detail: track metadata is passed to QML Text items without plain-text mode, allowing HTML-like media metadata to be interpreted as rich text and load referenced resources
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Added textFormat: Text.PlainText to all five Text items rendering track metadata and bumped version to 0.1.2

qml_quality_samples.detail: controller-supplied site identifier is used without confinement in report-cache path and curl configuration, allowing file overwrite; site name passed to Text using AutoText allowing rich-text injection; unbound response accumulation risking memory exhaustion; terminal escape sequence injection via site labels
qml_quality_samples.resolution: Validated controller identifiers against regex ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$, set PlainText on all Text items, bounded fetch page sizes to 1MB/5 pages, and stripped Unicode control/format characters
